benchmark: 2D XY cart / unrestricted passive spatial ball joints
variant: observed-state full-horizon native synthesis and feedback; zero hanging preparation
planning_wall_time_scope: recorded per-case execution segments; administratively resumed cases exclude earlier interrupted/cached preparation time; physical simulation does not advance during planning
qualification_accounting_scope: own actor plus independent case audit costs counted once; any uncheckpointed interrupted work additionally bounded, never called zero; no inherited cases
native_accounting_scope: sealed completed-path ledger plus first-reserved reproduction; uncheckpointed interrupted work additionally bounded, never called zero; planning and cold audits do not add samples
evidence_scope: all current distinct case motion/certificates/audits, full first-reserved caches, runtime and source; other raw models retained locally with exact regeneration hashes
archive_scope: complete current runtime and all new/changed evidence across listed current archives; unchanged historical evidence is covered by immutable prior bundles
